labels.note: Context change breaks translation lookup; e.g. French female ordinal for 10 falls back to 'th'.
English ordinal(10, gender='female') returns '10XXthXX'; also breaks the msgid for translations.
Context change breaks translated female suffix for 1 (e.g. French '1re' becomes '1st').
English ordinal(1, gender='female') returns '1XXstXX' instead of '1st'.
Context change breaks translation lookup for female 2 in translated locales.
English ordinal(2, gender='female') returns '2XXndXX' instead of '2nd'.
Context change breaks translation lookup for female 3 in translated locales.
English ordinal(3, gender='female') returns '3XXrdXX' instead of '3rd'.
